text: State changes automatically re-run only the code that depends on them (fine-grained reactivity)
quote: Declare your state and use it throughout your app, and when a piece of state changes, only the code that depends on it will rerun.

text: Built-in Context and Stores provide performant global state management without needing a third-party library
quote: Performant state management is built-in with Context and Stores: you don't have to reach for a third party library to manage global state

text: Resources let you treat server-loaded data as reactive state and build responsive loading UI via Suspense/concurrent rendering
quote: With Resources, you can use data loaded from the server like any other piece of state and build a responsive UI for it thanks to Suspense and concurrent rendering.

text: Full SSR and serverless support with streaming and progressive hydration for fast time-to-interactive
quote: Solid has full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration to get to interactive as quickly as possible.

text: Components render to real DOM elements, so browser devtools can inspect them directly
quote: A `<div>` is a real div, so you can use your browser's devtools to inspect the rendering

text: Custom renderers can be written to target platforms beyond the browser DOM
quote: Universal: write custom renderers to use Solid anywhere

text: Framework is web-component friendly and supports authoring custom elements
quote: Web component friendly and can author custom elements

text: Minimal abstractions give direct DOM access, making it easy to integrate native JS libraries like D3
quote: Solid's bare-metal, minimal abstractions give you direct access to the DOM, making it easy to use your favorite native JavaScript libraries like D3.

text: Components are plain JS functions that run once to set up the view, rather than re-rendering on each update
quote: Render-once mental model: your components are regular JavaScript functions that run once to set up your view

text: Supports modern framework features like JSX, fragments, Portals, Error Boundaries and concurrent rendering
quote: Provides modern framework features like JSX, fragments, Context, Portals, Suspense, streaming SSR, progressive hydration, Error Boundaries and concurrent rendering.

text: Components are isomorphic and can render on both client and server
quote: Isomorphic: render your components on the client and the server

text: Official CLI/template lets you scaffold a new project quickly via degit
Performance is almost indistinguishable from optimized vanilla JavaScript (no virtual DOM overhead)
quote: Solid's performance is almost indistinguishable from optimized vanilla JavaScript

text: Built on established tooling like JSX, TypeScript and integrates with the Vite ecosystem
quote: Solid is built on established tools like JSX and TypeScript and integrates with the Vite ecosystem.
